brand_notes.fabric: brands.json's brand-level fabric string is 'Dimension Polyant X-Pac VX-21 / VX-42, yellow 200d packcloth liner, closed-cell foam, CNC-machined ABS stiffeners'. This holds up well catalogue-wide: a diagonal diamond-quilted X-Pac stitch grid is visibly pressed into the shell fabric on all 7 products - clearest on the Silo, Giant Silo, Titan Tank and Custom Frame Bag close-ups, fainter but present on the tan/teal Wing Tank. The yellow packcloth drawcord liner is confirmed inside both Silo sizes. Unlike the Blackburn/Swift cases flagged elsewhere, this brand's fabric string is not overclaimed.
brand_notes.logoVariant: Two different woven/printed patches appear across the catalogue: a square black patch reading 'NUKE SUNRISE BIKE BAGS / Moab, UT' (Silo, Giant Silo, Mini-Pannier, Custom Frame Bag) and a round patch reading 'NUCLEAR SUNRISE STITCHWORKS' with a mushroom-cloud mark (Titan Tank, MegaTitan). Same shop location, same webbing/stitch style, same construction quality in every photo - read as a rebrand/renaming over time, not a wrong-product mixup. Not flagged per-product.

products.name: Silo
products.dims_note: Fixed cylinder, no roll/extend axis - the drawcord liner gathers at the mouth but the 15.2cm (6in) shell height does not shorten or lengthen. len and wid both the 10.2cm (4in) diameter.

geometry.notes: Straight-walled fabric cylinder, quilted X-Pac diamond stitch visible on the shell. One black webbing compression band at mid-height. Yellow packcloth drawcord liner visible above the shell rim, cinched by an orange cord and black cord-lock.

closure.hardware: orange drawcord through the yellow liner mouth, black cord-lock, small side-release buckle tab

details.fabric: X-Pac, visible diamond quilt stitch; yellow 200d packcloth liner

mount.notes: OneWrap velcro strap around any bar diameter at the stem, plus a 3/4in webbing strap down to the fork crown to stop the bag swaying side to side. Sits upright directly ahead of the stem.

products.name: Giant Silo
products.dims_raw: Specs - Main body 7.5" tall, 5" diameter. Cinch top extends 3" at the top.
products.dims_note: hgt is the 19.1cm (7.5in) MAIN BODY, i.e. the minimum/packed-down figure per the new rule; the cinch-top neck adds a further 7.6cm (3in) when pulled up, not included in dims_cm. len/wid from the 12.7cm (5in) diameter.

render.basis: main-body height as photographed with the drawcord neck cinched down flush, matching giant-silo-3 which shows the neck barely proud of the shell rim

geometry.notes: Flat panel on the bar-facing side (the mesh pocket and MOLLE webbing sit on this flat face), rounded elsewhere - a true cylinder overstates the diameter slightly. One black webbing compression band at mid-height. Yellow packcloth liner and drawcord identical to the standard Silo.

closure.hardware: orange/red drawcord through the yellow liner mouth, black cord-lock

details.fabric: X-Pac, visible diamond quilt stitch; yellow 200d packcloth liner
details.molle: PALS/MOLLE webbing rows on the flat attachment panel, plus a small side D-ring loop

mount.notes: Same mounting method as the Silo (bar velcro plus fork-crown webbing strap) but the flat D-panel and MOLLE row face the rider, with the mesh side pocket visible in-profile.

products.name: Titan Tank
products.dims_note: Foam/plastic-stiffened rigid shell, single fixed figure, no range. len is the 9in run along the top tube, hgt the 4.5in nose height, wid the 2in top-tube straddle width.

geometry.notes: Tall squared nose at the head-tube end tapering along a straight top-zip line down to a low, narrow tail. Flat bottom straddles the top tube.

closure.hardware: single exposed YKK slider, orange pull, no storm flap

mount.notes: Adjustable-position 3/4in velcro OneWrap plus a 2in sticky-back cinch strap; can also bolt on with washers/stiffener, or run on the seatpost per the maker copy. Rigid shell sits flush on the tube, no droop.

products.name: MegaTitan
products.dims_note: The MegaTitan page carries no dimensions and no litre figure at all, only that it's the larger Titan with internal divider pockets on both sides. dims_cm is a scaled-up estimate from the measured Titan Tank (same wedge proportions, visibly larger in-photo), not maker data. Not adjusted from brands.json's prior estimate - no better source found.

geometry.notes: Same wedge family as the Titan Tank, larger. Photos show a sloped top zip running the full length and two bolt-on/strap tabs at the base; no external side pockets are visible in either photo despite the maker copy describing the storage as 'internal divider pockets on both sides' - corrected from brands.json's external side/open pockets below.

closure.hardware: single exposed YKK slider, orange pull, no storm flap

mount.notes: Maker copy: CNC-machined ABS insert with two straps for a standard top tube, one long plus one short strap for conjoined top/down tubes on full-suspension frames, or washers for bolt-on. Not directly visible in these two studio photos - same mount family as the Titan Tank.

products.name: Wing Tank
products.dims_raw: DIMENSIONS - 5" (12.5 cm) diameter with a maximum rolled height of about 11" (28 cm). Approximately 215 cubic inches (3.5 L) volume.
products.dims_note: len/wid are the fixed 12.5cm diameter (a cylinder, no taper). hgt in dims_cm is kept at the maker's 28cm MAXIMUM per the honesty rule - no minimum is published to take instead - but see render.hgt_cm for what is actually drawn.

render.conflict: 28cm is the maker's only published figure and it is an unrolled maximum, not a minimum - drawing it verbatim would show the bag fully extended and untouched. wing-tank-3 is an on-bike photo of the bag compressed under two Voile straps on a King-style cage; measured against its own known 12.5cm diameter in that photo, the rolled/strapped height reads at roughly 1.5x the diameter, about 19cm.
render.basis: on-bike photo wing-tank-wing-tank-one-size-3-5l-3.png, proportion against the 12.5cm diameter

geometry.notes: Straight fabric cylinder, flat sewn base with a small logo tag. Faint diagonal X-Pac quilt visible even in the plain-color tan/teal shells.

closure.hardware: side-release buckle on a short webbing tab

mount.notes: Requires a third-party triple-boss cargo cage (maker copy: 'designed around the King Many Things cage', heavier VX-42 fabric at the cage-contact panel; cage and Voile straps sold separately) - does not strap to a bare fork leg. On-bike photo shows it slung in a cage on the fork with two orange compression straps cinching it down well short of its unrolled 28cm.

products.name: Mini-Pannier
products.dims_raw: Sold in pairs, these 6L capacity per pannier weigh in at 600 grams.
products.dims_note: The 6L is explicitly PER PANNIER, so capacity_l is correct as-is. No dimensions are published anywhere on the page; dims_cm is an unchanged estimate for a 6L panel bag of the shape seen in-photo (roughly square face, chamfered lower-front corner), not maker data.

geometry.notes: Near-square face panel with the lower-front corner chamfered off at roughly 45 degrees (heel/spoke clearance), flat back against the wheel. Three horizontal MOLLE/PALS webbing rows run across the front face.

closure.hardware: single slider with a reflective pull tab, small D-ring loop at the zip end

mount.notes: Two mount systems appear in the source material and do not obviously reconcile: the back-panel photo (mini-panniers-...-2, watermarked 'v1 attachment') shows a rigid metal top rail with two spring hooks and a single centre buckle strap - a QR rail-hanger system; the maker's current page copy instead describes '3-point Voile strap attachment to any rack'. Read as an older rail-hook version superseded by a simpler strap version, but not confirmed which is current - treat the rail-hook mechanism as illustrative only.

products.name: Custom Frame Bag
products.dims_note: Made to measure with options for standard triangle, horizontal/vertical-shock full-suspension, or half frame bag; no dimensions or litre figure published anywhere. dims_cm is an unchanged mid-range full-triangle estimate, not maker data.

geometry.notes: Full main-triangle wedge, tall squared nose at the head tube tapering to a narrow tail at the seat tube/BB. On-bike photo shows two zip runs (a main compartment across the top slope and a second smaller zip lower on the panel, likely an accessory pocket) and a continuous strip of loop tabs around the whole perimeter for lacing/zip-tying to the frame rather than buckle straps.

closure.hardware: single slider on the main compartment; a second smaller straight zip lower on the panel for an accessory pocket

mount.notes: Continuous perimeter loop-tab strip is laced through with cord (visible as orange/white paracord zig-zagged through the top-tube loops in the on-bike photo) rather than buckled - fixed/custom mount, or bolt-on via down tube / seat tube / top tube bosses per the maker copy.
